name: TimelineState
description: The timeline-specific state of a SlicerCache object.
remarks: Supported contiguous ranges can be set through the SetFilterDateRange method. When the timeline has such a contiguous filter state, the state can be retrieved from the two properties StartDate and EndDate. Any state that the filter may have, including non-contiguous states, can be retrieved through the three properties FilterType, FilterValue1, and FilterValue2.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TimelineState object. Read-only.

properties.name: StartDate
properties.description: Returns the start of the filtering date range. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: EndDate
properties.description: Returns the end of the filtering date range (equal to the StartDate property if range is a single day). Read-only Variant.

properties.name: FilterType
properties.description: Returns the type of date filter. Read-only XlPivotFilterType.

properties.name: FilterValue1
properties.description: Returns the first value associated with the date filter (semantics vary by filter type). Read-only Variant.

properties.name: FilterValue2
properties.description: Returns the second value associated with the date filter (semantics vary by filter type). Read-only Variant.

properties.name: SingleRangeFilterState
properties.description: True when the filtering state is a contiguous date range; otherwise, False. Read-only Boolean.

methods.name: SetFilterDateRange
methods.signature: SetFilterDateRange(StartDate As Variant, EndDate As Variant) As XlFilterStatus

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start of the filtering date range.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end of the filtering date range.
